notes: USMC fireteams use the M27 IAR as both rifle and automatic rifle; medics are Navy corpsmen with the same kit.
M17 is used for the sidearm because it exists in the game; the M18 is the same family.
M7 and M250 (NGSW) are listed as alternates: the faction file says they field to close-combat units, so the regular variant keeps M4A1 and M249.
Heavy tier with ESBI side plates follows the faction file; it also says patrols often drop side plates (medium).
M72 LAW is not in the game; it is an AT alternate with AT4 as game_substitute.
